sections.content: You know *creo que* and *me parece que* from B1 Unit 7: they take the indicative, and so does *considero que*. To evaluate something, use *es importante que* (A2 Unit 27) or the new *me parece preocupante que*, with the subjunctive.

items.spanish: Creo que la propuesta es positiva.
items.english: I think the proposal is positive.

items.spanish: Considero que la medida es eficaz.
Me parece preocupante que el servicio sea tan caro.
items.english: It seems worrying to me that the service is so expensive.

items.spanish: Es importante que las decisiones sean transparentes.
items.english: It is important that decisions be transparent.

sections.content: *Me parece que* + indicative gives an opinion (*me parece que la medida es eficaz*); *me parece preocupante que* + subjunctive evaluates (*me parece preocupante que el servicio sea tan caro*).
